cohort: 930 children under the age of 2 years in Lira district, northern Uganda, and their mothers
finding: Caesarean delivery, discarding initial breast milk, home delivery, and the mother being responsible for initiating breastfeeding were significantly associated with delayed initiation of breastfeeding, while maternal secondary education was associated with lower odds of delayed initiation.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was significantly associated with delayed initiation of breastfeeding.
followup_time: Up to 2 years (children under 2 years of age were included)
